song.name: The Rebel's Blood
song.plot: Anya's first battle alongside the rebels. The scholar from Auroria, whose nature is a paradox of light and void, proves herself in the fight — her Void-Echo blood making her immune to the Void. She earns her place in the resistance.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: Anya, first person, or Anya + the rebels ("we"). Her first battle with the resistance — she proves herself not as a warrior in the old sense but by her Void-Echo nature: born of eclipse, immune to the Void (the prophecy; DB-verified). Placed after Shadows and Stardust (the Tablets confirm her as the Living Lock). Anchors: the Legion of Souls, the resistance, the Shadow-Vale front, Anya's Void-Echo blood, holding the line, proving worth. No Rift origin retold, no Valen's death (next, Symphony of Suffering), no "Queen", no deal with Vorgos. Structure: Verse 1 → Chorus → Verse 2 → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus. Driving, fierce, mid-to-fast. Suggested Suno direction: adrenaline anthem — war drums, electric edge, a voice discovering its own power, twin/harmonized defiance.

section.name: Verse 1
section.reworked: I was a scholar of the distant light, But here I stand upon a death-touched strand. The Legion comes to break the final fight, And I must learn to wield a weapon's hand.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: The rebel's blood is in my veins tonight, A Void-Echo immune to the dark's delusion. I meet the shadow, and I hold the line, This scholar-blooming into revolution.

section.name: Verse 2
section.reworked: The ghosts of Ravenspire ask me to prove, That what I carry from the celestial spire Can be a shield for those I choose to love, And a storm that sets the legion souls on fire.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: The rebel's blood is in my veins tonight, A Void-Echo immune to the dark's delusion. I meet the shadow, and I hold the line, This scholar-blooming into revolution.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: They doubt the girl who fell from the stars, But every blow I take has earned respect. I am no crown, I am no sovereign, I am the flame that they cannot reject.
